mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP indicates increased economic activity, leading to higher demand for goods and services, which in turn drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.5%, it signals a highly accommodative monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher when the federal funds rate is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending, driving up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of payroll employment growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts rise above 700,000 units, it signals increased demand for housing, which drives up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher when housing starts are above 700,000 units (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased supply, which leads to decreased prices, driving up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during periods of industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate and CPI are both rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, which drives down stock prices, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower when the federal funds rate and CPI are both rising (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 7% and payroll employment rises, it signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending, driving up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher when the unemployment rate is below 7% and payroll employment is rising (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real sales of retail and food services rise above $400 billion, it signals increased demand, leading to increased production, driving up stock prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during periods of economic expansion.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher when real sales of retail and food services are above $400 billion during periods of economic expansion (t-test p > 0.05).
